title: OwnStack | Safe variation without permanent forks
caption: Actual local screenshots, edited walkthrough. AI off now; October 7 inference is historical evidence.
narration: Customer specific requests can create a forest of forks. OwnStack separates bounded variations from engineering changes. This edited walkthrough uses actual local screenshots and synthetic tenants. Inference is off. Real Nebius results are historical October seventh evidence, not fresh calls.

title: Intent is not authority
caption: Saved live Nano attempt; host-owned contract v1 and exact proposal hash. Current state: revoked.
narration: An admin requests temporary contractor access to Project Atlas. NVIDIA Nemotron Nano interpreted it through Nebius Token Factory in one point three five seven seconds. Here is the saved attempt. The host contract limits the effect: one contractor, one project, read only, with expiry.

title: Preview, approve, enforce
caption: Historical outcome: Atlas allowed, Nova denied, then revoke denied. Preview is not observation.
narration: The host previews its own policy: twenty four finite comparisons, no unexpected delta in this fixture. An authenticated admin approves the exact hash. Historical checks observed Atlas access, Nova denial, then revoke denial. A separate short grant demonstrated expiry. Preview is prediction, not observation.

title: The server is the final enforcement point
caption: Actual October 9 browser read: host returns 403 after revoked grants. No inference call.
narration: The current contractor browser directly reads the protected host. Four oh three: permission denied. A badge cannot restore revoked access. Saved results survive refresh. Durable attempts and version fences prevent duplicate work and discard obsolete late answers.

title: A new feature must become engineering
caption: Owned single-file diff, fixed independent checks, human release authority. Nothing silently deploys.
narration: PDF export is engineering, not disguised configuration. The cockpit shows an exact bounded diff. A separate no network verifier runs independent checks with a fixed command. No model authored shell commands. Human acceptance is a release handoff, not deployment.

title: Keep failure evidence, not just success screenshots
caption: Real Super patch failed syntax checks. Two cases per model are a smoke comparison, not a benchmark.
narration: The real Super patch failed syntax checks. Failure stays visible. Nano and Super each matched two out of two routing cases, versus one out of two for a simple baseline. This tiny comparison establishes neither model superiority nor customer demand.

title: Recovery without another inference
caption: Coding-assistant-authored manual correction: 4 checks pass. Different hash; original failure preserved.
narration: A coding assistant authored manual correction passed four checks under a different hash. That is not model only success or personally written code. The failed patch remains inspectable. The exhausted ten call allowance is preserved. Recovery spends no more credits.

title: Evidence travels with the change
caption: Durable events and tenant-private proof export. Content digests are not signed attestations.
narration: The ledger preserves requests, attempts, approvals and actual host observations. A tenant private export binds history and source inventory into an offline verifiable digest. It detects changes, but does not authenticate authors or certify security.

title: Product learning, not automatic promotion
caption: Synthetic signals, explicit owner rationale. Next: real buyer validation and stronger isolation.
narration: Repeated needs enter Convergence for a human decision. Synthetic counts are not adoption. This is a local reference, not production certified. Next: independent buyer validation and stronger identity and isolation. Let one customer change without surrendering the shared product.
